lead: Atique Ahmed was an Indian politician, born on 10 August 1962 in Prayagraj.
He died on 15 April 2023 in Prayagraj at the age of 60.
He has held the office of Member of the Lok Sabha and Member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly.
Below you will find a verified overview of Atique Ahmed: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

paras: Atique Ahmed works primarily as a politician and gangster.
